# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Summary decision
**No capability edit shipped this iteration — by design, not by omission.** All 10 val
trajectories are identical uncontrollable infrastructure failures. There is zero
skill-usage signal to diagnose, verify, or generalize from, so every conceivable edit
fails the REAL and VERIFIED tests. A speculative edit here carries only downside
(risking package validity → unscoreable) with no possible upside (reward is pinned at
0.000 by the Docker failure, so the gate cannot accept any non-significant change).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | INFRA (not a skill cluster) | all 10 | Docker build failed pulling `ubuntu:24.04` — `dial tcp: lookup registry-1.docker.io: i/o timeout`. Rollout never started; `tool_calls=0`, `trace=null`, `output=null` on every task. | N/A (environment noise) | none — cannot be fixed by a skill edit |

Tasks (all infra-errored, per the focus block): exceltable-in-ppt, financial-modeling-qa,
invoice-fraud-detection, offer-letter-generator, pdf-excel-diff, pptx-reference-formatting,
reserves-at-risk-calc, sales-pivot-analysis, weighted-gdp-calc, xlsx-recover-data.

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | none | — | No edit could pass the three tests (see below). | N/A — no passing tasks exist |

Why no edit passes the three tests:
- **REAL** — fails: no task exhibits a skill-caused failure. 100% are the explicitly
  excluded infra noise. There is not even a trace showing which skill the agent loaded.
- **VERIFIED** — fails: `trace=null` and `tool_calls=[]` on every task, so there is no
  observed input/output to run a guard, computation, or new script against.
- **SAFE** — a speculative skill/script edit risks breaking package validity
  (`validate()` rejects a non-compiling script or malformed frontmatter → "not scored at
  all"), which is strictly worse than the seed, with no offsetting upside.

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- N/A — no change kept, nothing to verify.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees: not used. The diagnosis (10/10 identical Docker DNS-timeout
  build failures, zero tool calls) was conclusive after reading every trajectory
  directly; fanning out subagents over no-signal traces would add cost without insight.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (this is the seed baseline; RUNMAP, LEDGER,
  rejected.jsonl and history.jsonl are all empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The seed skill packages (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) are VALID and untouched — keep them that
  way until a real trajectory shows a concrete, verifiable skill failure. Do not churn
  them speculatively.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- All 10 tasks — uncontrollable infrastructure noise (Docker registry unreachable). The
  focus block and each task's own feedback ("Uncontrollable noise, not a skill defect; do
  not optimize against it") both direct me not to optimize against them. No skill edit can
  make `ubuntu:24.04` resolvable.
